title: The Garden at the Edge of May
description: A deliberate callback course links flower bounces, fragile trellises, lift transfers and rain arches.

signs.text: Bounce into the garden · aim for the stone landing
Keep moving across the flowering trellis
Ride the garden lift onto the high terrace
Short jumps carry you under the blossom arches
Leave the waterfall onto the dry flower terrace
Climb the last switchback and look back over the garden
Link the final bounces to the garden gate
